rules.statement: A party who is present at a Fiscal's sale but fails to notify their title to the purchaser may be estopped from denying the plaintiff's title if there are circumstances that would have put the purchaser on notice of the potential defect in title.
rules.supporting_quote: "The first defendant, though present at the Fiscal's sale, did not intimate to the purchaser that he was entitled to this land. As to why the first defendant failed to do so, it is not necessary to record any finding. But evidently the first defendant did not wish to disclose the deed in his favour by the second defendant, who was the judgment-debtor."
